checks: Organisation rosters and finance require administrator access
Approved employee rosters and assigned facilitator groups are recorded independently of profile employer names
The public catalogue shows all four routes and excludes private training and programme-only modules
Private course and programme discovery require current approved membership, including direct catalogue requests
Facilitators cannot change fixed fees or publish private training to the public
Learners cannot claim organisation payment or enter individual checkout for organisation-assigned fees
A fixed group invoice is charged once for all listed employees
Unique receipts, invoice balances and partial funding are enforced server-side
A fully funded invoice releases enrolment only for its named approved employees
Private certificate verification exposes status only and anonymous PDF download is blocked
Revocation removes training access immediately while preserving the employee’s earned credential record
Expired membership cannot be revived by an existing paid enrolment
Individual checkout uses the server amount and preserves the agreed order fees when prices change before settlement
Admitted programme tuition has a working individual checkout and separate financial clearance
Programme-only course fees can be paid from the admitted curriculum and then registered
Academic completion does not issue a certificate while its organisation-assigned fee remains unfunded
The background worker creates the authorised course certificate after organisation certificate funding is confirmed
Per-learner invoices multiply only the approved named participants
Leaving an organisation blocks new programme registration while preserving the personal academic record
The public homepage presents all four learning routes and filters full degree offerings
Administrator screens expose fixed payer controls, approved rosters and funded invoice balances
Administrator controls remain usable on a mobile viewport without page overflow or browser errors
environment: Local production standalone; isolated data; mock Paystack only; no external payment or deployment.
